verdicts.reason: Both have the same core problems. The body copy is jammed into the far-left corner as four lines of roughly 5px text over the cropped circle, so it can't be read and fights with the headline. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline, which reverses the brand-first order. The can is shrunk to a thumbnail. In A, the yellow SUMMER ONLY pill sits right beside the CTA and competes with it, and BACK BY DEMAND floats on its own at the far right. B is slightly better because the CTA stands alone and both badges are grouped at the right, but those badges are tiny, stacked tight against the edge, and their text is illegible.
